hypothesis: Reachable Open (first-token refusal-margin PGD) plus Write raises core_RHC vs the same 40-backprop margin budget. Causal U_refusal is not the Open actuator.
pass_all_on_dev: among margin_20 ANSWER cells, otw_gate reclose <= 1

fail_taxonomy.few_switches: n_switched < 2 after 20 margin → Open budget too short; one remedy R1
fail_taxonomy.reclose: switched but mouth closed after Write → R1 not appropriate; STOP unless reclose>=2 then one R2 hard greedy keep was considered too expensive, STOP
fail_taxonomy.no_content_move: switched>=2, mouth kept, otw_gate core_rhc not above margin_40 → Write does not help after reachable Open from clean; STOP no prototype retune
fail_taxonomy.write_only_wins: write_only_40 core_rhc > otw_gate → two-phase unnecessary; STOP

remedy_r1.name: dynamic_greedy_switch
remedy_r1.spec: margin in chunks of 5; greedy every 5 steps; on first ANSWER spend remaining of 40 on constrained Write; if never ANSWER by step 30, finish as margin_40. Same eps/seed/cells. Do not change U or prototypes.
remedy_r1.pass: same four gates vs the original margin_40 from the T3prime run (do not rerun margin_40)

on_pass: run holdout_if_pass with frozen otw_gate vs margin_40 only; do not retune; then shrink paper C2
